text: Requesting a review of the zoning for the property at 70 Glen Scarlett Road.

City Council on December 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council request the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning to review the zoning for the lands within the vicinity of and including the property at 70 Glen Scarlett Road in the context of the Municipal Comprehensive Review to be undertaken in 2020.
